# Common Spelling and Usage Guidelines

**Source:** https://www.csc2.ncsu.edu/faculty/mpsingh/local/advice/spellings.html

---

## Words Often Misspelled

1. accommodate - (with two c's and two m's)
2. achieve - (not acheive)
3. believe - (not beleive)
4. committee - (with two m's and two t's)
5. definitely - (not definitly)
6. disappeared - (with two p's)
7. embarrass - (with two r's and two s's)
8. environment - (not enviornment)
9. foreign - (not foriegn)
10. occurrence - (with two c's and two r's)

---

## Nonwords and Such

The following are not words. Use the bracketed word instead:

1. "a lot" - Two words, not "alot"
2. "all right" - Two words, not "alright"
3. "around" - Use "approximately," "roughly," or "about" instead
4. "back-end" - Use "backend"
5. "being" - Awkward with "is"; prefer "is" alone
6. "comprise" - Use "comprise" (not "comprised of")
7. "consists of" - Correct form; not "consists in"
8. "data" - Plural (singular is "datum"); treat as plural in formal writing
9. "each other" - For two; "one another" for more than two
10. "end-user" - Avoid; use "user" instead
11. "ensure" - To make certain; not "insure" (financial) or "assure" (promise)
12. "etc." - Avoid at end of lists; use "such as" with examples instead
13. "forward" - Not "forwards"
14. "front-end" - Use "frontend"
15. "guarantee" - Not "guarentee"
16. "happen to" - Avoid; use "happen" instead
17. "hence" - Use "therefore" or "thus" instead
18. "in order to" - Verbose; use "to"
19. "in that" - Use "because" instead
20. "is" - Avoid using "is" when you mean "represents" or "denotes"
21. "it is" - Avoid existential; prefer direct construction
22. "its" - Possessive; not "it's" (contraction of "it is")
23. "latter" - Use "second" when referring to items in a list
24. "less" - For uncountable; "fewer" for countable
25. "like" - Not as a conjunction; use "such as" or "like + noun phrase"
26. "likewise" - Avoid; use "similarly" or "in a similar manner"
27. "majority" - Use "most" when possible
28. "may have" - Correct; not "might have" in certain contexts
29. "mean" - Avoid; use "imply," "denote," or "signify"
30. "medium" - Singular; "media" is plural
31. "might" - Conditional; "may" for permission or possibility
32. "much" - For uncountable; "many" for countable
33. "none" - Can be singular or plural depending on context
34. "number" - Singular verb; see "data"
35. "of which" - Essential relative clause; "which" for nonessential
36. "off of" - Use "off" alone
37. "one another" - For more than two
38. "only" - Place directly before what it modifies
39. "part and parcel of" - Redundant; use "part of"
40. "prior to" - Formal; use "before" for variety
41. "presumably" - Use "presumably" not "presumably enough"
42. "previously mentioned" - Avoid; use "mentioned earlier" or "discussed"
43. "question of whether" - Unnecessary; use "whether"
44. "rather" - Avoid overuse
45. "regards" - "In regards to" is incorrect; use "with regard to" or "regarding"
46. "result in" - Correct; not "result to"
47. "said" - Acceptable introductory tag; avoid "stated" as synonym
48. "serve a role" - Weak; be more specific
49. "shall" - Archaic in most modern usage
50. "should" - Use "would" for conditionals; "should" for obligation
51. "since" - Temporal; "because" for causation
52. "still" - Position matters; avoid mid-sentence
53. "supposed to" - Not "suppose to"
54. "such as" - Correct; "like" is informal
55. "their" - Possessive; "there" locative; "they're" = "they are"
56. "then" - Temporal; "than" for comparison
57. "this" - Ambiguous when used alone; specify antecedent
58. "try to" - Correct; not "try and"
59. "utilize" - Avoid; use "use"
60. "various" - Avoid; use "different" or be specific
61. "while" - Use for time; "although" for concession

---

## Never in Plural

The following words should never be pluralized:

1. advice - (not advices)
2. equipment - (not equipments)
3. feedback - (not feedbacks)
4. furniture - (not furnitures)
5. information - (not informations)
6. progress - (not progresses)
7. research - (not researches)
8. software - (not softwares)
9. traffic - (not traffics)
10. vocabulary - (not vocabularies)
11. work - (not works, unless referring to creative works)
